(def descendants
  "Returns the immediate and indirect children of tag, through a
  relationship established via derive. h must be a hierarchy obtained
  from make-hierarchy, if not supplied defaults to the global
  hierarchy. Note: does not work on type inheritance relationships."
  (fn
    ([tag] (descendants @(get-global-hierarchy) tag))
    ([h tag]
     (if (suss.bootstrap/type-constructor? tag)
       (throw (suss.bootstrap/error "Can't get descendants of classes"))
       (not-empty (get (:descendants h) tag))))))
rationale: Expand the complete pinned defn to def/fn, retaining its documentation (#30). A type tag throws Clojure's "Can't get descendants of classes".
